name: Schedule options for Microsoft Project
description: Windows MDM settings in the Schedule options for Microsoft Project category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Show assignment units as (User)
properties.description:
Shows resource assignments units as a decimal or percentage.

If you enable this setting, resource assignment units will be set to the option you choose from the list.

If you disable or do not configure this setting, the user's default setting is used.

properties.name: Show scheduling messages (User)
properties.description:
Displays messages about schedule inconsistencies, such as a successor task starting before the finish of the predecessor task.

If you enable this setting, users will be alerted about scheduling inconsistencies.

If you disable or do not configure this setting, the user's default setting is used.
